subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite this stale branch on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or close it only after the paired issue has a viable replacement path?
rationale: The branch has useful recovery intent and a paired open issue, but it crosses stale protocol and session-lifecycle boundaries where automation cannot choose the ownership and upgrade-safety path.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the recovery intent while using the current filtered active-run, protocol-package, and restart-drain contracts.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The contributor can update this branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another merge review.

options.title: Close after a viable replacement
options.body: If another proof-positive PR becomes the safe fix path for the linked issue, this stale branch can be closed as superseded then.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the recovery intent while using the current filtered active-run, protocol-package, and restart-drain contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main Gateway shutdown and split Control UI chat lifecycle history makes this the best available routing owner for the rework decision.
